description: This file defines an enum 'PermissionEffect' indicating permission statuses such as 'GRANT' and 'REVOKE' within the Eclipse Ditto model policies package.

classes.name: PermissionEffect
classes.description: Enum representing permission effects (grant or revoke) in policy management.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the string identifier ('grant' or 'revoke') associated with the permission effect.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the permission effect, same as 'id'.
